results.title: Watch: Sir Alex Ferguson Struggles To Walk In Protective Boot As Legendary Manager Attends Man United vs Ipswich Town At Old Trafford
results.description: Sir Alex Ferguson returned to Old Trafford to watch Manchester United vs Ipswich Town, but his arrival drew attention as the legendary manager appeared to struggle while walking. Ferguson was seen wearing a protective boot and receiving assistance outside the stadium as Michael Carrick's Red Devils seek their first Premier League win of the season.
